The '''Gallo Mountains''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] chain that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The settlement of [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]] was situated upon the summit of a mountain within this chain.<ref name="CoN">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref> The [[Summit Farm Blossom Winery]] was also located in the mountains.<ref name="EG" />

==History==
[[File:Gallo_Mountains.jpg|230px|thumb|Map of the Gallo Mountains]]
The indigenous [[Species/Legends|species]] of Naboo, the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], revered a [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Sacred Place]] in the [[Lianorm Swamp/Legends|swampy]] foothills of the Gallo Mountains.<ref name="ItWoSWEI">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the criminals known as the [[Darkwalkers]] shot down a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] in order to steal a bio-scanner. The shuttle crashed in the mountains, and the Darkwalkers plundered the wreckage.<ref name="SWG:FowtDtftCS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Find out what the Darkwalkers took from the Crashed Shuttle|Naboo}}</ref>
